alignment.coverage: shared valid reference-image pixels; uncovered borders remain transparent

assumptions: fixed aperture, ISO and white balance
reference-only motion does not reconstruct occluded, clipped or blurred detail

deghost.fallback: all RGB channels in measured motion use only the reference exposure; its noise and clipped detail are retained
deghost.method: radiance disagreement against the selected reference; 3px closing and 2px expansion

response.calibration_precision: 256 encoded levels per RGB channel; interpolated onto original float capture values
response.normalization: inverse_response[128] = 1 independently in R, G and B; absolute radiometry and white balance are not calibrated
